description: MedinTux opens to a practitioner authentication screen. Click on any practitioner name from the list on the left to log in. Then create a new prescription (ordonnance) for patient 'BERNARD Pierre' (born 1968-11-30). The prescription should include: Medication 1: 'BISOPROLOL 5mg comprimés' with dosage '1 comprimé le matin', Medication 2: 'FUROSEMIDE 40mg comprimés' with dosage '1 comprimé le matin à jeun'. Duration: 1 month. Open the patient's file in MedinTux, navigate to the prescriptions section, and create the new ordonnance with these medications.
